Format: all required headers present and in the paper's shape (STATES, INITIAL_STATE, nonempty FINAL_STATES whose members u2/u4 are declared and accepting, TRANSITION_FUNCTION as (state, guard) -> state, REWARD_FUNCTION as (state, guard, state) -> reward). Guards are predicate-only and the persistent/event distinction is handled correctly: the event box_fell triggers the watch state, and the persistent condition holding_box one step later confirms the very next move was a pickup. That correspondence is exact: only a pickup can refill the hands after a fall, box_fell and holding_box never co-occur, and after a 'face'-mode fall the box always lands in front with the agent turned toward it, so a next-step pickup always succeeds. Ordered transition coverage matches the environment's guaranteed order (first fall always at steps 2-8, at most one second fall 2-6 steps after the second pickup, no fall on an episode-ending step, so u1/u3 always receive a judgment step): u0->u1->(u2|u5) unrolls fall 1, u2->u3->(u4|u5) unrolls fall 2, a skipped second fall (hands empty at the due step) correctly leaves the machine in u2, and falls after a miss are absorbed by u5's else loop. Irrelevant propositions (siren_ringing, switch_toggled, at_exit) and ordinary movement steps are covered by the per-state else self-loops; the else loops in u1/u3 are dead since their guards are exhaustive, which is redundant but harmless and format-consistent. Reward safety: rewards are bounded (+2 max, -1 per miss), non-farmable (u1 and u3 are each entered at most once, no per-step drips, the u5 sink pays 0 so no unbounded accumulation), and semantically aligned: +1/+2 exactly at each immediate pickup, -1 exactly when the move after a fall is not a pickup, including a judgment step that ends the episode at the exit or the step limit. The accepting set is right: the run ends in u2/u4 iff every fall that occurred was picked up on the very next move; ending in u0 cannot occur because the first fall always precedes any possible arrival at the exit. Minor, non-blocking: after a miss the machine never re-arms, so a later correctly handled fall earns nothing extra; this matches the violation-is-permanent monitor reading of the task ('try' applies per fall and a missed next move cannot be undone) and is acceptable.

def siren_ringing(env): return env.siren_ringing

def switch_toggled(env): return "toggle" in env.events_this_step

def holding_box(env): return env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "box"

def box_fell(env): return "fall" in env.events_this_step

def at_exit(env): return env.grid.get(env.agent_pos[0], env.agent_pos[1]) is not None and env.grid.get(env.agent_pos[0], env.agent_pos[1]).type == "goal"
